body:
## Why

Decapod #1628 needs an instance-scoped local/cloud connector and typed managed authentication/account transport. Existing adapter selection alone does not provide this lifecycle.

## Changes

- Recover connector/native RPC source from immutable bef1a565819c67f5403dd24ed6a35163a3a788eb under a newly admitted task without inheriting earlier proof.
- Bind public discovery, browser handoff, repository identity and expiry; preserve explicit entitlement/authority denials and uncertain mutation outcomes without replay. Caller retains private credential and pending-flow custody.
- Retain explicit SQLite, Neon and Supabase service APIs, optional feature combinations, Rust 1.75 and current-bearer native RPC.
- Configure ring and WebPKI roots per HTTPS client, preserving normal TLS verification without ambient provider effects or the unused HTTP/3 dependency graph. The independently reviewed lock removes 17 unused packages without dependency upgrades or replacements.
- Adopt a reviewed repository-local native proof contract and match the CI controller to the release-bound entrypoints.

## Evidence

This PR is created only by the released native workspace publisher after its complete workbranch boundary on candidate {{HEAD_SHA}} against accepted main {{BASE_SHA}}. Two mandatory native groups retain the complete fourteen-check suite: formatting, all features, seven other feature combinations, clippy with warnings denied, specific missing-real-fixture failure, Rust 1.75, clean consumer resolution and package verification. Their scoped runtime union preserves every reviewed canonical dependency under the released controller hashing limits; aggregate declared execution time remains 3600 seconds. Hosted controller CI, Pages and release remain explicit separate execution scopes.

## Remaining boundary

Loopback tests establish client transport behavior. No hosted PostgreSQL, managed Auth, seat/payment policy, deployment or registry publication is asserted. This ordinary library PR retains package version 0.11.1. Decapod #1628 remains blocked on the subsequent released Dactyl dependency; no downstream registry check or package handoff is weakened.

Closes #100.

Required proof command declarations must have nonempty unique names in ascending lexical order. Placing the MSRV declaration before the stable declaration preserves both mandatory groups, all fourteen check arguments, complete runtime coverage and the existing timeout budgets. Declaration order and its reviewed digest are configuration prerequisites, not evidence that a product check passed.

repo.product_summary: Establish Dactyl as the governed datastore boundary for Decapod, allowing callers to execute the same query contract against either local SQLite or remote Neon-backed storage without changing application logic. Dactyl must select the requested datastore, analyze SQL before execution, reject unsupported dialect constructs when rewriting is disabled, apply permitted rewrites when enabled, and preserve a narrow public API that does not expose adapter internals.
